reviews.review:
[b]Merits:[/b]
▪ Faithfully expands on the source material 
▪ Thrilling, intense combat experience
▪ Visually appealing
▪ Variety of environments
▪ Co-op multiplayer

[b]Flaws:[/b]
▪ Short campaign (even with the DLC)
▪ Repetitive gameplay
▪ Grindy, lacklustre progression
▪ AI companions are not great, so not really solo-friendly

[b]Verdict:[/b]
For the full price, I don't think it's worth it.
However if you love the Alien universe and have 3 friends that you can play it through with, the game does offer a solid co-op shooter experience.

[b]Rating:[/b] ★★★☆☆ - Above Average

Good game play but as others have said online there are issues, one big one that just happened to me was all data was deleted for no reason. 
I came back to play it and was greeted with make a new character, I tried to restore it but had no luck so I made a new one hoping it might fix itself but after loading in everything is gone.
All mission progress and unlocks, every last thing has gone and I mean all of it. 
Lifetime stats show no kills, time played or anything so be warned if you do start playing that for no reason you might come back to everything gone. 

I will update as I have messaged the developers but from what I can see online they have never helped or fixed it.

Quick update, I sent another email asking for some kind of response but nothing so it would appear that the company have no intentions of fixing it or at least responding so any future games from them I would stay clear as if this is how they deal with there games now I can only imagine that they will act the same way with future games.
Wish they did more with this game! Such a blast :D

Good game to get at a discount. It's worth about 40 bucks and that's with the DLC included. Good pass time with a group when your in-between games. Finish the campaign and grind out the achievements for the hardest difficulties.
